# Code of conduct

Participation in Baguette Tycoon must remain respectful and free from harassment.

## Standards

Use welcoming language, respect differing viewpoints and accept constructive criticism. Focus feedback on the work rather than the person.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory language, personal attacks, sexualized content and unwanted attention are unacceptable.

## Enforcement

Emrecan45 maintains these standards and may remove inappropriate content or restrict participation. Report concerns privately to the project owner through an existing contact channel. Do not post another person's private information in an issue.
